title: kill-zero reports a killed unreaped zombie alive 187
symptom: The native process liveness probe reports a killed, unreaped child as alive
trigger: A child is SIGKILLed and its parent has not waited for it yet
expected: The probe treats a zombie as not alive while still detecting a running child
actual: kill -0 succeeds and the regression fails
steps: Spawn sleep 60 and confirm the helper detects it
SIGKILL the child without waiting, then probe it and reap it before asserting
impact: The timing, native and change tests can falsely report a surviving process under load (#187).
source: GitHub issue #187 and deterministic regression at 599ff184
